meta.aggregationPolicy: The build script deduplicates athletes across imported TeamUSA.com roster sources in memory, then strips athlete names, profile URLs, images, biographies, medals, finish placements, and other individual-level fields before writing frontend data. State cards display aggregate public Team USA athlete counts only where needed for fan context.
meta.hometownAreaPolicy: Top hometown areas are city-level aggregate public athlete counts only, require at least 1 public athlete, and do not expose athlete names, profiles, images, or individual records.
meta.bucketPolicy: Combined state bucket: insufficient data = 0 sourced public athletes, low = 1-4, medium = 5-19, high = 20+. Low-volume program panels may show a fallback sport cue when public athletes exist; stronger featured sport signals have 3+ sourced public athletes.
meta.coverageNote: Only TeamUSA.com Paris 2024 and Milano Cortina 2026 roster records with a U.S. state or supported U.S. territory abbreviation in the public hometown state field are used for cards. Unsupported or blank geography values are excluded from card output.
